description: Renovate keeps the sha256-pinned release downloads in the workflows current (gitleaks,
actionlint, osv-scanner, the Codacy coverage reporter), which Dependabot cannot see, and the
container images pinned as tag@sha256: the fuzz image's base (.clusterfuzzlite/Dockerfile), the
images of this repository's two ClusterFuzzLite actions (.github/actions/cflite-*/action.yml) and
the Scorecard action's image recorded in scorecard.yml. For an image it proposes the tag's new
digest when the tag moves, never another tag: the Scorecard tag follows the action's version,
which Dependabot updates.
Everything else stays with Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml, which has no docker entry), so
the two never propose the same update: the github-actions manager reads the two local action
files only, never a workflow.
Each pinned download is marked in its step's env with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=owner/repo`
line directly above the VERSION (the release tag) and SHA256 lines. The
github-release-attachments datasource finds the asset the current sha256 belongs to and
proposes the new tag together with that asset's new sha256. A pinned image in a workflow is an
*IMAGE: 'name:tag@sha256:...' line under `# renovate: datasource=docker`.
The registries these images live on (gcr.io, ghcr.io) give Renovate no release timestamp, and
with the default timestamp-required a digest update would wait on minimumReleaseAge forever, so
docker updates are raised without one (Renovate docs, minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour).
tests/unit/part19.py and part242.py gate that every pin is matched and that each manager reads
only its own files.
The add-ons' pins (panel/services/addons.py): B3's source commit, which follows
FMSMITH91/big-brother-bot master (git-refs, in addons.py and the B3 Containerfile together),
IW4MAdmin's image, the digest of its `latest` tag, and the B3 image's base, the digest of
python:3.12-slim (B3_BASE in addons.py and ARG BASE_IMAGE in the B3 Containerfile together;
written by digest alone, as podman takes it, so the tag Renovate follows is the manager's
currentValueTemplate), and BlueMap's image, the digest of its `v5` tag (a new 5.x release, never
a new major one). All four are checked daily (packageRules). The B3 image's Python
dependencies (panel/addon_images/b3/requirements.txt, pip-compile's lock of requirements.in)
stay with Dependabot, like every other pip lockfile here: Renovate runs no pip manager.

customManagers.description: Workflow release downloads pinned by tag and sha256
Workflow container images pinned by tag and digest
The B3 add-on's source: FMSMITH91/big-brother-bot master, pinned by commit
The IW4MAdmin add-on's image: the digest of its latest tag
The BlueMap add-on's image: the digest of its v5 tag
The B3 add-on image's base: the digest of python:3.12-slim, in addons.py and the B3 Containerfile together

packageRules.description: Images: the tag's new digest only, never another tag
gcr.io and ghcr.io publish no release timestamp: raise the digest update rather than hold it forever
The fuzz build's base and the two ClusterFuzzLite action images move together
The add-ons' pins are checked every day; B3's fork is this project's own, so its commits need no waiting period
B3's fork: no release-age wait (a commit to master is the release)
